_comment: Revision request — the fix list posted to the developer. Self-service loop (DESIGN §1.23.6): the dev's own triage produces this list every round, so the header is neutral about who decided; PREFIX_PARAGRAPHS carries the approver's reinstate note when one applies (§1.23.9), MANUAL_ISSUE_PARAGRAPHS any newly discovered human MR comments. Legacy path: approver marked indices in TRIAGE_DECISION/AWAITING_APPROVAL. Both optional slots default to [].
